fusions.name: Drawn Venom
fusions.desc: Flicks a needle that deals 8 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Purging Thrust
fusions.desc: A precise thrust that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Purge
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tolerance Drill
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
